nowazure

Cinematic scenes built inside Roblox Studio, and the design work that surrounds them — thumbnails, marks, and moodboards, all cut from the same light.

SCROLL

Every piece starts the same way: find where the light falls, then build the scene around the shadow it leaves. That's the vignette — not a filter added after, but the actual frame the work is composed for.
